newsitem.title: POLAND: KOREAN LG GROUP TO HOLD STRATEGY MEETING IN WARSAW.
newsitem.headline: KOREAN LG GROUP TO HOLD STRATEGY MEETING IN WARSAW.

text.p: South Korea's LG Group will hold a two-day meeting on its development strategy in central and eastern Europe and former Soviet Union countries in Warsaw on September 5, a company official in Poland said.

The official, who asked not to be named, said 50 to 60 members of the diversified group's top management would discuss its investment and development plans, which, in the case of Poland, could top $300 million over the next five years.
The meeting is likely to set guidelines mainly for investment in the telecommunications, property development and petrochemical industries.

In June the group announced it agreed to take a new issue of Poland's Petrobank SA shares for 133.5 million zlotys ($49.3 million), which would give it a controlling stake of 50 percent plus one share.
